reason: I need full-page shots once a month when I hand a site over, not daily monitoring, and my extension plus the free 15-page tier covers that. Paying a subscription to watch sites I've already handed off isn't something my clients pay me for.
objection: Honestly, I could rig up Playwright to crawl a sitemap and grab full-page desktop and mobile shots in an afternoon, so $9 a month for something I'd use twelve times a year feels like paying for a cron job.
would_change_my_mind: If a client started paying me for an ongoing care plan where I have to prove nothing broke each month, the change alerts and a before/after link I can send them would earn the $9.
